# 2 Baruch Chapter 72 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Cloud and Waters Vision
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 72:3 — judgment of the nations

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "some-of-them he-will-spare, and-some-of-them he-will-slay" |
| LOGOS | "some of them he will spare, and some of them he will slay" |
| PNEUMA | "sparing some of them and slaying others" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS. The Syriac antithesis spare/slay (nshibu/neqtul) is preserved as a parallel structure by LOGOS; PNEUMA's participial conversion loses the rhythmic force.

---

## 72:4 — criteria for sparing the nations

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "every-nation-that-has-not-known-Israel, and-that-has-not-trodden-down the-seed-of-Jacob" |
| LOGOS | "every nation that has not known Israel, and that has not trodden down the seed of Jacob" |
| PNEUMA | "every nation that has not known my people, that has not oppressed Israel, and that has not trampled on the seed of Jacob" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS. PNEUMA adds an extra clause ('that has not oppressed Israel') that is not in the Syriac source; the original has a bicolon, not a tricolon.

---
